question: Renowned Rajasthani folk dancer Gulabo Sapera is recognized for __________ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalbeliya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulabo Sapera **is a renowned Rajasthani folk dancer who is known for her **Kalbeliya dance**.
 
• Kalbeliya is a traditional dance form of Rajasthan, which is performed by the Kalbeliya community. It is also known as the snake dance as it depicts the movements of a snake.
 
• The tale of Kalbelia dancer Gulabo Sapera is one of resilience and refusing to give in to peer pressure.
 
• Gulabo, who has traveled to over 165 countries promoting the Sapera dance form of Rajasthan, is a fervent supporter of the art and was awarded the Padma Shri in 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bihu is a folk dance of Assam, which is performed during the Bihu festival. It is a celebration of the harvest season.
 
• Garba is a folk dance of Gujarat, which is performed during the Navratri festival. It is a celebration of the victory of good over evil.
 
• Jhumar is a folk dance of Haryana, which is performed during weddings and other festive occasions. It is a celebration of joy and happiness.
